replacements.El bucle de entrenamiento: tres piezas,: The training loop: three pieces, one mechanism
replacements.Todo modelo de aprendizaje automático aj: Every machine-learning model adjusts its parameters through the same loop, from a 1980 regression to GPT-4. The three pieces are inseparable.
replacements.Cuantificar cuánto se equivoca el modelo: Quantify how wrong the model is
replacements.El primer elemento es una función de pér: The first element is a loss function. It compares the model's prediction with the correct answer and produces a number that represents the error. The larger it is, the worse. Without this measure there is no direction for improvement.
replacements.y = valor real &nbsp;·&nbsp; ŷ = predicc: y = true value  ·  ŷ = model prediction  ·  ℒ = total error
replacements.calcular en qué dirección deben cambiar: to calculate in which direction the parameters should change to reduce the error
replacements.Distribuir la responsabilidad del error: Distribute responsibility for the error layer by layer
replacements.Regla de la cadena aplicada a redes mult: The chain rule applied to multilayer networks. The calculated error propagates backward from the output, assigning each weight a measure of how much it contributed to the failure. Without this, training deep networks was unfeasible.
replacements.∂ℒ/∂W = cuánto contribuyó W al error tot: ∂ℒ/∂W = how much W contributed to the total error  ·  applied to each layer, from output to input
replacements.convirtieron el backpropagation en el mé: made backpropagation the central method for training multilayer networks
replacements.Moverse en la dirección del error menor: Move in the direction of lower error
replacements.Descenso de gradiente estocástico: actua: Stochastic gradient descent: update each weight by a small fraction (the learning rate) in the direction opposite the gradient. Repeat with each batch of data. The model converges toward parameters that minimize the loss.
replacements.η = tasa de aprendizaje &nbsp;·&nbsp; ∇ℒ: η = learning rate  ·  ∇ℒ(W) = gradient calculated by backprop
replacements.idéntico en una regresión logística de 1: identical in a 1980 logistic regression and in GPT-4 training; the scale changes, the mechanism does not
